text: Connect text and voice goal entry to model-backed proposal generation
description: Invoke proposeAimSubtree from the existing text and browser-voice entry surfaces, display generation progress/errors, preserve an explicit manual-draft fallback, and feed successful results into the same recursive review/approval UI. No model response may persist directly.

status.comment: Text and voice entry are connected to model-backed proposal generation with manual fallback; internally verified and awaiting live configured-model/UI acceptance.

reflection: Text entry now offers “Propose with model” and “Start manually,” shows generation progress/errors, and opens the shared review UI for either result. Browser speech calls the same proposeAimSubtree endpoint; if model configuration/inference fails it opens a manual draft and explains the fallback. No generation path calls approval or graph writes. Verification: focused proposal tests 8/8, full frontend tests 207/207, frontend type-check, production build, and git diff check.
